name: agent-factory-3d
description: A local 3D dashboard that shows your real AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) as robots in a factory. Read-only.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/agent-service install && npm --prefix apps/dashboard install
scripts.test: cd apps/agent-service && npm test && cd ../dashboard && npm test
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/agent-service && npm run typecheck && cd ../dashboard && npx tsc -b
